concerns: The experimental comparisons are not controlled: baseline optimization status, alignment interface, post-fusion training budget, gate, and checkpoint-selection rule are undocumented, so the reported RLPF advantage cannot be attributed to the proposed geometry.
Key reproducibility details are missing, including the truncated SVD construction, gate architecture and training schedule, and per-baseline adaptation mechanism.
Reported point estimates lack repeated-trial uncertainty, and the manuscript explicitly states no statistical significance can be claimed.
Efficiency claims are internally inconsistent: the displayed resource table shows RLPF has the highest latency and compute, contradicting the inference-speedup claim.
scholarly_quality.concise_summary: While the conceptual formulation of curved-space parameter fusion is innovative, the experimental record is missing essential experimental controls, complete procedural specifications, and statistical variance estimates. This extensive scientific uncertainty warrants an uncertain rating.

recorded above, indicating a different configuration or an

Under the displayed measurements, PlainMamba has
the lowest parameter count, FLOPs, memory, and latency,
whereas RLPF has the highest values and the highest
recorded ImageNet accuracy. RLPF is approximately 8.6%
slower than the displayed ViT latency and 32.2% slower than
PlainMamba, so these data support an accuracy–resource
trade-off rather than an inference-speedup claim. A valid
final comparison requires one fixed protocol covering hard-
ware, software versions, batch size, precision, image reso-
lution, warm-up, timing repetitions, and gate policy. If soft
routing evaluates both branches before logit fusion, it cannot
realize single-branch latency without a separately defined
hard-routing mechanism.

blocking_reasons: The experimental comparisons are not controlled: baseline optimization status, alignment interface, post-fusion training budget, gate, and checkpoint-selection rule are undocumented, so the reported RLPF advantage cannot be attributed to the proposed geometry.
Key reproducibility details are missing, including the truncated SVD construction, gate architecture and training schedule, and per-baseline adaptation mechanism.
Reported point estimates lack repeated-trial uncertainty, and the manuscript explicitly states no statistical significance can be claimed.
Efficiency claims are internally inconsistent: the displayed resource table shows RLPF has the highest latency and compute, contradicting the inference-speedup claim.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Classification accuracy is measured on standard image benchmark test/validation splits rather than by the optimization objective.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Top-1 classification accuracy on standard test/validation splits of CIFAR-10, Oxford-IIIT Pet, and ImageNet-1K.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Supervised task loss with gate-balance regularization optimizing the hybrid branches and learned gate, plus geodesic barycenter minimization and validation-selected curvature hyperparameters.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims regarding convergence rates, guaranteed numerical stability, and inference acceleration are not substantiated by the evidence, as acknowledged in the text itself. In particular, efficiency tables show RLPF incurs higher latency and compute overhead than either individual parent model.
primary.evaluation_assessment: Comparisons across CIFAR-10, Oxford-IIIT Pet, and ImageNet-1K report point estimates without error bars or multi-seed standard deviations. Critically, the fine-tuned hybrid RLPF is compared against baselines whose post-fusion fine-tuning budgets, alignment interfaces, and gate controls are undocumented.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Top-1 classification accuracy evaluated on standard image benchmark test/validation splits.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Standard top-1 classification accuracy on test/validation splits of CIFAR-10, Oxford-IIIT Pet, and ImageNet-1K.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Supervised task loss (cross-entropy plus gate balance regularization) optimizing the hybrid branches and learned gate, along with geodesic barycenter minimization.

primary.limitations: The manuscript candidly acknowledges critical limitations, including the lack of controlled baseline training budgets, incomplete SVD implementation details, missing error bounds, and the hybrid nature requiring retention of both architectures.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is mathematically formulated in the Lorentz model, but key experimental details are missing or incomplete. Specifically, the truncated SVD alignment construction, gate architecture and training parameters, and baseline adaptation mechanisms are not fully documented in the manuscript.
primary.quality_rationale: While the conceptual formulation of curved-space parameter fusion is innovative, the experimental record is missing essential experimental controls, complete procedural specifications, and statistical variance estimates. This extensive scientific uncertainty warrants an uncertain rating.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces Riemannian-Lorentz Parameter Fusion (RLPF), a method combining Vision Transformers and State-Space Models into a two-branch hybrid via semantic parameter grouping, SVD latent alignment, anchored Lorentz geodesic barycenter calculation, and learned logit gating.

scholarly_quality.rationale: While the conceptual formulation of curved-space parameter fusion is innovative, the experimental record is missing essential experimental controls, complete procedural specifications, and statistical variance estimates. This extensive scientific uncertainty warrants an uncertain rating.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The manuscript candidly acknowledges critical limitations, including the lack of controlled baseline training budgets, incomplete SVD implementation details, missing error bounds, and the hybrid nature requiring retention of both architectures.
